title: The close button on the widget explorer doesn't behave like the taskbar close button
line: Closing the Widgets sidebar opened from the panel's context menu now leaves edit mode instead of opening Panel Settings.
explanation: Since the fix for bug 493048, closing the Widgets sidebar always opened Panel Settings when the sidebar belonged to a panel, meant for coming back after Panel Settings' Add New > Widgets…. The sidebar could not tell that case from opening it through the panel's context menu, so that path also ended in Panel Settings and edit mode stayed on. The sidebar now records whether the panel was being configured when it opened (Panel Settings now opens the sidebar just before closing itself so this can be seen) and only then returns to Panel Settings; otherwise it exits edit mode unless edit mode was entered from the desktop, the same rule Panel Settings' own close uses.

commits.message:
explorer: only reopen Panel Settings when the sidebar came from there

Closing the Widgets sidebar opened from a panel's context menu opened
Panel Settings, which is only right when it was opened from there. Track
that case and otherwise exit edit mode, as closing Panel Settings does.

BUG: 522315

media.caption: Master: right-click panel > Add or Manage Widgets…, then the sidebar's X: Panel Settings opens and edit mode stays on
With the fix: same steps, the sidebar closes and edit mode is exited

review.text: Minimal, well-scoped fix that distinguishes opening the Widgets sidebar from Panel Settings versus the panel context menu by opening the sidebar just before closing Panel Settings and capturing containment.userConfiguring synchronously in Desktop.qml. Closing the sidebar now returns to Panel Settings only when opened from there (preserving bug 493048) and otherwise exits edit mode unless edit mode was entered from the desktop, matching Panel Settings' own close button.

reviews.text: Minimal, well-scoped fix that distinguishes opening the Widgets sidebar from Panel Settings versus the panel context menu by opening the sidebar just before closing Panel Settings and capturing containment.userConfiguring synchronously in Desktop.qml. Closing the sidebar now returns to Panel Settings only when opened from there (preserving bug 493048) and otherwise exits edit mode unless edit mode was entered from the desktop, matching Panel Settings' own close button.

Fixes exactly the reporter's case: closing the sidebar opened from the panel context menu now exits edit mode, using the same enteredEditModeViaDesktop() rule as PanelView's config toggle, while the Panel Settings > Add New > Widgets round trip (bug 493048) is kept by recording userConfiguring at open time. The reorder in PanelConfiguration.qml is safe because ShellCorona::toggleWidgetExplorer invokes the QML synchronously before the config view hides. Before/after screenshots and the regression matrix (desktop-entered edit mode, toolbar button, Escape) cover the relevant paths; commit message and line match the patch.
